title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds 23 Kodansha USA Catalog Titles, Dricam!! From Shueisha
content: Crunchyroll announced on Wednesday it is partnering with Kodansha USA to add manga titles from Kodansha 's back catalog to the Crunchyroll Manga app on May 18. Crunchyroll will also add You Chiba's Dricam!! from Shueisha to the app on the same date.
author: ANN

title: Will Ascends the Tower in Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Episode 6 Preview, New Trailer Revealed
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the preview images and synopsis for Episode 6 (Episode 18 overall) alongside a new trailer. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide, with Episode 6 scheduled to premiere on May 17.
author: Anime Corner

title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Reveals Second Story Visual Featuring Scenes From Episode 6
content: Witch Hat Atelier revealed a new story visual following the release of Episode 6 in Japan. Studio BUG FILMS ( Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead ) is in charge of the animation, with Crunchyroll streaming the anime globally. The anime has been the best-voted non-sequel every week of Spring 2026 so far .
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Reveals More Cast, New Key Visual
content: The staff for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga announced more cast members this past week, along with a key visual of 20 cast members on Wednesday.
